items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 142:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the addition of power? From the aspect of the fixed Mochin of Aba and Ima and ZON, there is no power in them to give birth to souls. And in order that they have the power to give birth to souls, Aba and Ima need to receive an addition of power beyond their fixed measure, namely, they need to receive from AA the Mochin of AB — the GAR of the lights and the NHY of the vessels. And likewise ZON from Aba and Ima. And since they are not the principle of the Partzuf, therefore they are called the addition of power. (Item 13).
